in_sanskrit.name: Saheel
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Friend, Companion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saheel एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Saheel is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sahyah', which means friend, companion, or helper. This name is often given to a child who is expected to be a source of support and comfort to others.
